FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Precision Accounting Solutions specializes in providing comprehensive accounting and financial services for individual taxpayers and small businesses. Our operations primarily focus on individual tax preparation, ensuring compliance with current tax regulations while offering basic bookkeeping and payroll processing services. We maintain accurate financial records for sole proprietors and small partnerships, utilizing secure, industry-standard accounting software for data management. Our team, composed of certified public accountants (CPAs) and trained bookkeepers, adheres to strict data security protocols to protect client information. We conduct regular internal audits of our accounting practices to ensure compliance with legal and industry standards, and we maintain clear, written client engagement agreements that outline services and fees. It is important to note that we refrain from providing financial planning, investment advice, or wealth management services, as they are outside the scope of our operations and increase regulatory risk.

Our company offers comprehensive financial planning and investment advice services, helping clients achieve their financial goals through personalized wealth management strategies.
